originality.rationale: The published October 26, 2026 FOUR-DISTINCT-SEASONS theorem covers the entire submitted variable-exchange claim under a simple exact time rescaling. Given phase duration t_j and rate mu_j, replace with constant migration m=1, duration tau_j=t_j*mu_j and new intrinsic rates r_ij^prime=r_ij/mu_j. This makes exp(t_j G_j) exactly exp(tau_j G_j^prime) for each j. All ordered products are identical. Prior contrasts b_j^prime=(r_1j-r_2j)/(2mu_j)=q_j/2, so its three dihedral orderings and exact trace difference are the same. Its Floquet exponent normalized by sum(tau_j) differs by a common positive factor from normalized by sum(t_j), preserving ranking and signs. Prior work also certifies a growth/decay witness. Thus original not original even though its parameterization says mu varies.
residual_risks: The earlier theorem describes fixed migration in its coordinates, but transformation is exact and no distinct invariant survives.
